		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SPR_the_sovereign_crown }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_SPR_the_sovereign_crown
				add_idea = COLDWAR_SPR_caudillos_successors
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SPR_caudillos_successors } }
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_SPR_caudillos_successors
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SPR.1.a
		trigger = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_bop_value > 0.19 }
			NOT = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SPR_fet_spain_without_franco check_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_bop_value < -0.49 } }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_SPR.1 option a"
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 23 } } } set_temp_variable = { rul_party_temp = 23 } set_temp_variable = { disable_elections = 1 } change_ruling_party_effect = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { party_index = 23 }
		set_temp_variable = { party_popularity_increase = 0.1 }
		set_temp_variable = { temp_outlook_increase = 0.1 }
		change_relative_party_popularity = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_power_balance = { id = COLDWAR_SPR_regime_bop } }
			add_power_balance_value = {
				id = COLDWAR_SPR_regime_bop
				value = 0.05
				tooltip_side = COLDWAR_SPR_regime_bop_apertura_side
			}
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_bop_value = 0.05 } clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SPR_bop_value min = -1 max = 1 } }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SPR.1.b
		trigger = {
			has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SPR_fet_spain_without_franco check_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_bop_value < -0.49 }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_SPR.1 option b"
